scope: isolated PostgreSQL concurrency, idempotency, billing, refund, and terminal-state verification

database.isolation: temporary data directory, dedicated port, dedicated wujie_test database

proved: concurrent duplicate requests create one authoritative task
concurrent charge attempts create one consume transaction
failed/cancelled/timeout competition permits one terminal transition
terminal settlement creates at most one refund transaction
late completion cannot resurrect failed, cancelled, or timeout tasks
missing credit account cannot be mislabeled as refunded
core-v2 tasks remain authoritative after new admissions roll back to legacy
remaining: provider late-completion rejection evidence in the deployed environment
